scope: SG->FR repatriation skeleton (highest-value facts). MIXED AUDIENCE: three host-exit (Singapore) obligations for Adrien as a non-EEA EP holder (IRAS tax clearance via Form IR21 at least 1 month before last day; employer EP cancellation within 1 week of departure, which also cancels family Dependant's Passes; no CPF to unwind because CPF is only for SCs/SPRs) and four home-re-entry (France) obligations for him as an EEA national (notify the non-residents tax office of the new French address; check/adapt the prelevement a la source rate to avoid the default rate; the return-year income-declaration split via 2042-NR + 2042; re-affiliate to French Assurance maladie via form S1106/PUMa). destination_country is set to the ISO-2 country where each obligation applies (SG for host-exit, FR for home-re-entry). nationality per audience: SG-exit = non-EEA, FR-re-entry = EEA (never null). Tax facts mapped to the EMPLOYMENT pillar per loader convention. All records candidate-only, awaiting human/lawyer verification.
